sections.description:
Short title and commencement

CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S ORDER 6 OF 2002
CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S ORDER 6 OF
2002
NATIONAL SECURITY COUNCIL
ORDER (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2002
(An order to amend the
National Security Council Order, 2001)
No.2‑13/99‑Min.II,
dated 25‑2‑2002.
Whereas it is expedient to amend
the National Security Council Order, 2001 (Chief Executive's Order No.5 of
2001), for the purpose hereinafter appearing.
Now, therefore, in pursuance of
the Proclamation of Emergency of the fourteenth day of October, 1999, and
Provisional Constitution Order No. l of 1999, and in exercise of all powers
enabling him in that behalf, the Chief Executive of the Islamic Republic of
Pakistan is pleased to make and promulgate the following Order:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑(1) This Order may be called the National Security
Council Order (Amendment) Order, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

(An order to amend the

No.2‑13/99‑Min.II,
dated 25‑2‑2002.
Whereas it is expedient to amend
the National Security Council Order, 2001 (Chief Executive's Order No.5 of
2001), for the purpose hereinafter appearing.
Now, therefore, in pursuance of
the Proclamation of Emergency of the fourteenth day of October, 1999, and
Provisional Constitution Order No. l of 1999, and in exercise of all powers
enabling him in that behalf, the Chief Executive of the Islamic Republic of
Pakistan is pleased to make and promulgate the following Order:‑‑
2. Amendment of Schedule,
Chief Executive's Order No. 5 of 2001.‑‑‑In the National
Security Order (Chief Executive's Order No‑5 of 2001), in the Schedule,
in the third paragraph, for the words, commas and figure "issued by the
Chairman Joint Chiefs of Staff Committee, Chief of Army Staff and the Chief
Executive of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan on the Fourteenth day of October,
1999 and all subsequent Orders issued by him" the words "and all
subsequent Order made or issued by the Chief Executive of the Islamic Republic
of Pakistan" shall be substituted.
